title: Wasm Linear Memory Batching & View Detachment
description: Trace how batching into Linear Memory avoids trampoline overhead and how memory.grow() detaches TypedArray views.

steps.label: 1. Write Batch to Linear Memory
steps.description: JS copies input bytes once into WebAssembly.Memory.buffer via a Uint8Array view instead of looping over FFI calls.

steps.label: 2. Wasm Calls memory.grow()
steps.description: Allocation exceeds current 64KB page; engine grows Linear Memory to 128KB and detaches the old JS ArrayBuffer.

steps.label: 3. Re-wrap Fresh TypedArray View
steps.description: JS constructs a fresh Uint8Array over memory.buffer at ptr to read the processed batch safely.
steps.codeHighlight: const out = new Uint8Array(wasm.exports.memory.buffer, ptr, len);
